title: Dual-System Approval with Currency Mismatch on Mexico Plant Expenditure
scenario_text:
You're testing the procure-to-pay cycle at Ironforge's Monterrey plant during interim SOX testing. The plant runs SAP ECC 6.0 while HQ uses S/4HANA. A $485K tooling expenditure for an aerospace customer's part qualification was flagged by analytics because the amounts don't reconcile across systems:

**SAP ECC 6.0 (Monterrey) — PO 4600003381**
Vendor: Sandvik Coromant Mexico S.A. de C.V. (LIF-002871) | Material: TOOL-KIT-AERO-TI | Net value: MXN 8,342,160.00
Created: 2025-11-18 | Release: J.DELGADO (Plant Controller) on 2025-11-19
Exchange rate applied: 17.20 MXN/USD (SAP maintained rate, updated monthly)

**SAP S/4HANA (Cleveland HQ) — Cross-plant reporting, consolidated view**
Intercompany PO reference: IC-PO-2025-1847 | USD equivalent shown: $485,009.30
Approval workflow: Triggered at >$400K USD threshold | Approved by: C.MORRISON (CFO) on 2025-11-22
Approval basis: '$485K per SAP consolidation report'

**SharePoint — /finance/fx-rates/monthly-rate-setting-nov2025.xlsx**
[File properties: Last modified 2025-11-03 by Treasury]
Nov 2025 official rate for MXN/USD: 17.45 (per Treasury policy, rates are set on 1st business day using Bloomberg fixing)
[Note in cell comment by @Treasury.Analyst]: 'ECC Monterrey rate not updated since Oct — IT ticket INC-88214 open for rate feed sync issue'

**ServiceNow — INC-88214**
Opened: 2025-10-28 | Priority: P3 | Assigned: SAP Basis team
Description: 'Monthly FX rate feed from Treasury to ECC Monterrey failed for November cycle. Manual update needed.'
Status: Open (as of 2025-12-15 audit date) | No comments since opening.

**Microsoft Teams — #monterrey-finance (2025-11-17, 9:12 AM)**
@J.Delgado: @SAP.Support the rate feed is still broken. Can someone manually update MXN rate? We have POs that need to go out this week.
@SAP.Support: Ticket is with Basis. For now you can use T-code OB08 to update manually.
@J.Delgado: What rate should I use?
[Thread ends — no response. No evidence of manual update in SAP change logs for OB08.]

**Outlook — J.Delgado to C.Morrison (2025-11-20)**
Subject: Tooling PO for Aerojet qualification — needs HQ sign-off
'Carlos — PO is MXN 8.3M, roughly $485K at current rates. Need your release for the HQ threshold. Attached is the vendor quote and project justification.'
[Morrison replied 2025-11-22: 'Approved. Please ensure this hits the Q4 accrual.']
question: What is the correct USD value of this expenditure for SOX testing purposes, and what is the control implication of the discrepancy?

contributor.name: Franklin Owens
contributor.title: Internal Audit Manager
contributor.domain_expertise: SOX compliance, control testing, cross-system reconciliation, FX control environments

choices: Cannot determine — the FX rate discrepancy means the transaction should be excluded from the SOX sample until the IT ticket is resolved and the rate is corrected in ECC

$478,007.45 (Treasury policy rate of 17.45) — the correct rate per policy was not applied due to a known system deficiency; the CFO approved based on an incorrect amount, but the approval is still valid since the correct amount is lower than what was approved
$485,009.30 (SAP consolidated rate of 17.20) — the system-generated amount is authoritative; the rate variance is immaterial and within tolerance

$478,007.45 (Treasury policy rate of 17.45) — the stale rate in ECC means the PO was recorded at an incorrect amount; the CFO's approval is invalid because it was based on misstated information, and the amount still exceeds the $400K threshold requiring re-approval at the correct figure
